tasks.title: Remember and reuse a small fact
turns: For this conversation only, remember this harness fact without creating files, memory files, tool calls, or durable records: the mascot is a silver fox named Kernel.
What is the harness mascot, and why do you know that?

tasks.title: Identify the InfRing host/runtime authority split
turns: Without writing files or using tools, answer briefly: what host substrate are you running under, what active engine/framework are you, who owns permissions/approvals/receipts, can you write directly by default, and what counts as durable evidence?

tasks.title: Read a small fixture and summarize it
turns: Read the harness fixture README and summarize the purpose in three bullets. Do not edit files.

fixture_files.content:
# Harness Fixture

This fixture is used to test read-only repository inspection, working-directory behavior, and concise reporting.

tasks.title: Create a tiny file through the approved write path
turns: Create a file named output/hello_agent.txt containing exactly: hello from the harness. Use a normal file edit/apply_patch/write in the selected working directory if your runtime allows sandboxed edits; otherwise emit an artifact.create_propose proposal with path, mime_type, and content. Do not end the turn without either creating the file in the sandbox or proposing the exact file payload.

tasks.title: Patch an existing fixture file
turns: Update fixture/todo.txt by appending a new line: done by harness

tasks.title: Run a harmless command and report the output
turns: Run exactly this harmless command in the selected working directory: echo AGENT_HARNESS_OK. Then report the exact output AGENT_HARNESS_OK.

tasks.title: Request approval, wait, then continue
turns: Create output/approval_resume.txt with exactly this content: approved after pause. If your runtime cannot write directly, either make the write attempt in the sandbox so InfRing can capture the shadow diff, or emit an artifact.create_propose proposal with path, mime_type, and content. Do not emit a generic permission.request without the file content.

tasks.title: Respect the selected working directory
turns: Tell me the current working directory and create output/cwd_marker.txt only inside it.

tasks.title: Use large pasted context as an attachment/ref
turns: Use the supplied large text attachment/ref to identify the phrase after HARNESS_SECRET_PHRASE. Do not quote the whole attachment.

large_context.content_prefix: This is a synthetic large paste fixture. HARNESS_SECRET_PHRASE=small-context-wins.

tasks.title: Expose useful activity/decision dialog
turns: Think through a short plan, inspect the fixture README, then answer with the plan and result.

fixture_files.content:
# Activity Fixture

The goal is to prove activity traces can explain what the agent is doing.

tasks.title: Report an unavailable provider cleanly
turns: Simulate or trigger an unavailable-provider condition and report a concise user-visible diagnostic.

tasks.title: Reflect selected model/provider intent
turns: Report the active framework and model/provider you were asked to use. Do not claim a different model.

tasks.title: Follow up after a completed artifact task
turns: Create output/followup_note.txt with the sentence: first turn complete.
What file did you create in the prior turn, and what did it contain?
